newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Arab-Malaysian Corp bonds upgraded - RAM.
newsitem.headline: Arab-Malaysian Corp bonds upgraded - RAM.

text.p: Malaysia's Arab-Malaysian Corporation Bhd's 460 million ringgit private debt securities issues were upgraded to a rating of P2 from P3 by Rating Agency Malaysia (RAM), the agency said on Thursday.
RAM said the upgrade had been awarded on the back of "improved profitability of the group in financial year ended March 31, 1996".
Arab-Malaysia's ability to control operating risks in core business areas also supported the upgrade, said RAM.
"Adequacy of future operating cashflows in meeting principal debt repayments would be partly dependent on the future sale of various development properties held by the group," it said.
